# Family-aware headline results (generated by exp/fam_tables.py)

RMSE (same units as Table 2, mean over held-out models) with 95% CI. `model` = bootstrap over held-out models, `family` = bootstrap over organisations.
main = random folds; famfold = family-held-out folds; famfoldx = famfold without the family that carries >30% of the mean-predictor MSE.
